versions.changelog:
- Initial release of chief-of-staff-onboarding-coach.
- Provides structured coaching for new Chiefs of Staff navigating their first 90 days.
- Covers key areas: role definition (archetypes), principal alignment, stakeholder navigation, and operating cadence setup.
- Outlines common pitfalls and how to avoid them.
- Includes detailed guidance for the critical first 30 days, including stakeholder interviews and company document review.
- Defines clear triggers for when to use the coach, focused specifically on CoS onboarding scenarios.
